name: hint
title: Hint
description: A hint text component for form fields with icon, error, disabled states, and composed mode. Uses namespace exports: Hint.Root, Hint.Icon, Hint.DefaultIcon, Hint.Composed.

migration.guide: v2 adds `Hint.Composed` — a props-driven wrapper with a built-in default info icon. Also adds `Hint.DefaultIcon` (inline SVG). No breaking changes from v1.

docs.lead: A hint text component for form fields with icon support, error/disabled states, and a composed shorthand with built-in default icon.
docs.usage:
import * as Hint from "@/components/ui/hint"

<Hint.Composed>This is a hint text.</Hint.Composed>

examples.title: Demo
examples.code:
<Hint.Root>
  <Hint.Icon as={RiInformationFill} />
  This is a hint text to help user.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.code:
<Hint.Root disabled>
  <Hint.Icon as={RiInformationFill} />
  This is a hint text to help user.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Has Error
examples.code:
<Hint.Root hasError>
  <Hint.Icon as={RiInformationFill} />
  This is a hint text to help user.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Props-driven hint with default icon, error, and disabled states.
examples.code:
<Hint.Composed>This is a hint with default icon.</Hint.Composed>
<Hint.Composed hasError>This hint has an error.</Hint.Composed>

api.name: Hint.Icon
api.description: Icon displayed before the hint text.

api.name: Hint.DefaultIcon
api.description: Built-in info circle SVG icon used as the default in Hint.Composed.

api.name: Hint.Composed
api.description: Props-driven hint with a built-in default info icon. Pass custom icon via the icon prop.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon component. Defaults to built-in info circle.
